summary.conclusion: The revised flow removes duplicate wording and preserves parallel work. Initial trials exposed difficult artwork recovery; all ten cards are now published, including the nonprofit card after its approved brief revision.
summary.method: Ten distinct AI agents used normal signed-in browser UI and actual generated artwork. Creation used the updated local builder and production backend. All cards are fictional online demos for Monday, October 26, 2026; no invitations or responses were sent. This is AI task testing, not human research or a completion-rate study. UI timings measure provider jobs. The implementation evolved during testing: the revised nonprofit attempt used advisory non-safety checks, and desktop preview placement was subsequently fixed. Intended timezone was Central; most screens displayed Event local time. Public URLs were verified as the signed-in owner with owner-workspace redirects; signed-out access was not tested.
priorities: 1. Make artwork readiness and recovery consistent

State one clear result: Ready, Needs a wording fix, or Optional style concern. Explain the issue in one sentence; keep detailed diagnostics collapsed. Preserve the existing background and exact words during an explicit lettering repair. Show checking when re-verifying an existing image.

Offer In person / Online with the relevant venue or event-link field and a visible timezone summary. Keep provider-backed venue resolution in final preparation. Put date, time and location beside Publish in full-screen Preview.
3. Show the actual wording edit before Apply
Present the current and suggested wording together, then offer Apply suggestion or Keep my wording. Retain one canonical title/opening editor and preserve unsaved logistics.

Do not require a taxonomy choice to generate. Put Occasion above the examples it changes, or make an inferred occasion visible and editable. School, team and fundraiser creators could already proceed with General event.
5. Shorten the ordinary path; preserve advanced controls

Hide a different end date behind an option; make one guest message primary with clearly named additional notes. Keep optional RSVP, registry, reference and generation quality controls. Show a selectable public link when native Copy or Share is unavailable.
